title: Rumoured Couple Liam Neeson And Pamela Anderson's Net Worth Explored | Hollywood News - News18
text:
Liam Neeson and Pamela Anderson have been grabbing attention while promoting their upcoming film, The Naked Gun. While fans are excited about the movie, it’s their off-screen chemistry that’s been sparking buzz. From candid interviews to joint red-carpet appearances, speculation about a possible romance has been heating up. The rumours gained more traction after the duo attended the film’s New York City premiere together, accompanied by their children. As the two continue to make headlines, here’s a look at the net worth of both stars. Liam Neeson-Pamela Anderson’s Net Worth
Recommended Stories Liam Neeson Spending Time With Pamela Anderson's Sons In Canada, Is 'Smitten' By Actress? Pamela Anderson, Liam Neeson Are Dating? PDA By The Naked Gun Co-Stars Spark Rumours Liam Neeson-Pamela Anderson's ‘Sincere' Relationship Is Making Headlines Pamela Anderson Talks About Playing Femme Fatale In The Naked Gun: 'I Work A Lot On…' Pamela Anderson, once the iconic face of Baywatch, has built an estimated net worth of $20 million, according to Celebrity Net Worth. She first gained fame as a Playboy model before landing her breakthrough role as a lifeguard on the hit TV series. In recent years, she opened up about the emotional toll of fame in her 2023 Netflix documentary Pamela, A Love Story, where she spoke candidly about heartbreak, public scrutiny, and financial struggles.
advetisement Meanwhile, Liam Neeson commands a far larger fortune, around $120 million, thanks to a long and respected career in Hollywood. Known for powerful performances in films like Schindler’s List and the Taken franchise, Neeson remains one of the industry’s most bankable and enduring stars.
Liam Neeson-Pamela Anderson Spotted At Premiere
Recently, Liam Neeson attended the premiere of their film The Naked Gun with his two sons, Michael and Daniel, whom he shared with his late wife, Natasha Richardson. Pamela Anderson was accompanied by her children, Brandon and Dylan. The six of them posed for photos in front of The Naked Gun posters, generating even more excitement for the already-newsworthy occasion.
The Naked Gun reboot will star Liam Neeson and Pamela Anderson. The film, set to be released in Indian cinemas on August 1, 2025, combines classic comedy with nostalgic references to the iconic original. Liam Neeson plays Lt. Frank Drebin Jr., the earnest yet chaotic son of the renowned investigator, while Pamela Anderson portrays Beth Davenport. Akiva Schaffer directs and Seth MacFarlane produces the film, which stars Paul Walter Hauser, CCH Pounder, Kevin Durand, Cody Rhodes, Liza Koshy, Eddie Yu, and Danny Huston.
